notes.title: Doodle Harmony Ghosts Is Out Now!
notes.content:
👻 Get ready for a new adventure in the charming universe of Doodle Harmony! We proudly present the latest release: Doodle Harmony Ghosts! 👻

Find and match 100 pairs of cute doodles scattered across the screen in this point-and-click game. Can you match them all? 👻✨

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2776180/Doodle_Harmony_Ghosts/]Doodle Harmony Ghosts[/url]

notes.content:

👻 Get ready for a hauntingly fun new adventure! 👻

Dear Doodle Harmony fans,

We are thrilled to share some exciting news - Doodle Harmony Ghosts, is on its way!

If you've already fallen in love with the vibrant doodles and engaging gameplay of Doodle Harmony, brace yourself for a completely new experience with a ghostly twist.

What to expect from Doodle Harmony Ghosts:

🎨 New charming effects with a spooky touch
👻 Brand new ghostly doodles
🎵 Original Spine-Chilling Soundtrack!
Add it to your Wishlist now!
Don't miss the chance to be one of the first to dive into this exciting adventure. Add Doodle Harmony Ghosts to your Steam Wishlist and stay tuned for more updates.

Free Demo during Steam Next Fest!
Want to try before you buy? During the upcoming Steam Next Fest next month, we'll have a free demo available for everyone! Don't miss the opportunity to explore a snippet of the world of Doodle Harmony Ghosts.

We appreciate your continued support. We can't wait to share this unique journey with all of you. Stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Doodle Perfecte Placement
notes.content: Great news! We've resolved the technical glitches that led to the temporary rollback. Our latest update ensures flawless precision in Doodle placement, eliminating overlaps and delivering an enhanced experience. Thank you for your patience, and we can't wait for you to explore the improved Doodle Placement Precision! 🚀✨

notes.title: Rolling Back: Doodle Placement Precision Update Reversed Due to Technical Glitch
notes.content: Regrettably, we've had to roll back our latest update promising impeccable precision in Doodle placement due to unforeseen bugs. We're diligently addressing these issues and aim to have you enjoying a seamless experience soon. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding as we fine-tune this exciting feature! 🚀🛠️ #DoodleUpdate #TechnicalMaintenance

notes.title: Enhanced Doodle Features and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting news, Steam gamers! We've just rolled out an update to improve your Doodle experience and fix a few pesky bugs. Check out the changes:

Sleek Doodle Display: The timer and doodle counter are now semi-transparent with a stylish hover effect for enhanced visibility.

Doodle Placement Precision: Say goodbye to overlapping doodles! Now, it's impossible to place two doodles in the same spot unless they're the perfect match.

Neat Pause Menu: The pause menu has been revamped to prevent it from memorizing positions, ensuring a clean and organized gaming experience.

Bug Squashing: We've fixed a bug where doodles could be moved even with the game paused. No more unintended doodle shuffling!

Enjoy an upgraded Steam experience with these fantastic improvements. Happy gaming! 🎮✨"

notes.title: Control Sound in the Pause Menu
notes.content: This update brings an exciting new feature: you can now adjust the game's sound directly from the pause menu! Customize your gaming experience by fine-tuning the audio to your liking. Try out the latest version and enjoy full control over your favorite game's sound. Have fun!

notes.title: --Hotfix localization problems
notes.content: --The game had some localization issues in the pause menu and has been fixed.

notes.title: Doodle Harmony Playthrough
notes.content:
Doodle Harmony is a beautiful Point and Click game.
100 pairs of doodles are waiting for you to match them.

Relax with a spectacular original soundtrack!

Found 2 matching ones? Drag them to their counterpart.
